items.t: Nine-speed automatic failure or slipping into neutral
items.note: The 2015 warranty extension (6 years/100,000 miles) has likely run out, but ask a dealer with your VIN. A used transmission costs less.

items.t: Harsh, late or erratic shifts from the nine-speed
items.job: Transmission software update and quick learn
items.note: Often covered by the dealer if under warranty.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption on the 2.4L
items.job: Oil consumption test, then engine long block if it fails
items.note: Covered for 7 years/100,000 miles on eligible 2015-2018 vans built through Aug 8, 2018. The test itself is cheap; the engine is the big cost.

items.t: Cooling fan motor wears out and the engine overheats
items.note: Free under notice V54 on eligible 2015-2017 vans with the older bushing-type fan.

items.t: Power steering rack can crack and leak (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: ABS module can fail without warning (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Turn signal flash rate doesn't warn of a burned-out bulb (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Child seat may not stay locked in by the seat belt (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Trailer brake lights don't work (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Wrong tire pressure and load label (recall)
items.note: Free at a dealer when your VIN is included in the recall.

items.t: Parking brake sticks or won't hold in cold weather
items.job: Replace rear brake shoes and parking brake cables

items.t: Brake squeal or grinding
items.job: Replace front brake pads and hardware
items.note: Rear shoes and wheel cylinders add cost if the noise is from the back.

items.t: Sudden loss of power or limp mode
items.job: Diagnose limp mode and repair the cause
items.note: Price covers testing and a typical sensor or wiring repair; a failed transmission or engine part costs much more.

items.t: Oil leak from the oil filter housing or cooler
items.job: Replace oil cooler or filter adapter and seals

items.t: Cracked cylinder head needing a new engine
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured 2.4L
items.note: Replacing just the head costs less if the block is undamaged.

items.t: Clunk at low speed from worn front axle joints
Squeaky or noisy door hinge
Door handle or latch binds or won't open
items.job: Replace door latch or outside handle

items.t: A/C stops blowing cold
items.job: A/C diagnosis, leak test and pressure sensor or recharge
items.note: A compressor or evaporator replacement costs much more.

items.t: Check engine light for small evaporative leak
items.job: Smoke test and replace leaking EVAP part

items.t: Battery drains when parked
items.job: Battery test, parasitic draw test and repair
items.note: Add a new battery if the old one is damaged from repeated draining.

items.t: Dash display hard to read or goes dark
Headlight bulbs burn out often
